scope: Targeted two-host management TCP test; not whole network page or distributed GPU coverage
command_note: Requires two real agent nodes and the private config JSON described in test/e2e/RUNNING.md. Not runnable without it.

cases.name: 管理网络 / UI 选择两个真实节点进行 1 秒吞吐测试 / 双向传输成功、刷新保留结果且临时监听器退出
prerequisites: Explicit remote base_url, node_uuid and second_node_uuid; credentials only in private config
Two distinct online agents on different hosts with different routable management addresses
Both agents expose host terminal for read-only listener verification
Both nodes have unique human-readable names in the management network selector
No other management-network test is running
Environment preparation safely onboards the temporary agent without orphan cleanup affecting existing workloads
Short bidirectional unthrottled 1-second TCP traffic is permitted on the shared management link

crud.Create: UI submits one network test after single-node validation blocks mutation
crud.Read: GET and browser reload preserve the exact returned run ID, node set and pair measurements
crud.Update: N/A: completed test runs have no update API
crud.Delete: N/A: management-network test runs have no delete API; product retains latest 10 runs

fields.persisted: NetworkTestRun.Seconds; not exposed by public DTO

checklist_items.1: PARTIAL: deterministic node selection, invalid selection without mutation, exact successful request and persistence
checklist_items.5: PARTIAL: selected-nodes scope and mesh pattern only
checklist_items.8: PARTIAL: searchable multi-select, keyboard selection and minimum cardinality
checklist_items.12: PARTIAL: named pair dialogs, actual viewport, keyboard open/Escape close and focus return
checklist_items.16: PARTIAL: real task finishes and exact result survives refresh; cancellation not available

runtime.scope: Two real hosts exchange authenticated TCP traffic over management addresses; no Docker or GPU requirement
assertions: Exactly A-to-B and B-to-A pairs pass with positive finite RTT and Gbps, no error codes
Every target host matches the selected node management IP and uses a valid ephemeral port
API pair values, displayed values and refreshed result are consistent
Both agents have no LISTEN socket for the corresponding completed test port
Network definition, attachments and selected-node routing remain unchanged
evidence_limits: Agent throughput is based on peer-reported received bytes, but public DTO does not expose byte counts or actual duration
Positive throughput proves communication, not a performance threshold or exclusive physical path
No claim for RDMA, NCCL, accelerator P2P or distributed inference

cases.cleanup: Agent-owned ephemeral listeners are verified closed on both hosts. Completed run ID is retained and mapped to the local runId as product history. Environment preparation owns temporary agent/node cleanup; the case checks baseline GPU process identities remain unchanged.
missing: Other scope/pattern/throughput options and full numeric boundaries
Packet loss, offline agent, blocked ephemeral port, interrupted run and server restart recovery
Precise byte-count conservation through public API
